title: XR - Mobile Renderer + DX12 in VR doesn't render the right eye.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.1.stable.mono.official.14d19694e


### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 23.92 GiB memory

### Issue description


XR - Mobile Renderer + D3D12 in VR doesn't render the right eye.

I'm using OpenXR with a Vive headset on Windows on a desktop computer with a NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094). 

If I swap my "Driver.windows" from d3d12 to vulkan, both eyes render as expected.
If I swap from Mobile to Forward+, both eyes work in both d3d12 and vulkan.

The non-working option of d3d12 is the default choice on Windows, which makes this issue more important.

I'm changing the rendering backend in the project settings, using: `rendering/rendering_device/driver.windows`.

---
Additional useful logging:

Both Eyes Working:
```
Godot Engine v4.6.1.stable.mono.official.14d19694e - https://godotengine.org
OpenXR: Created instance for OpenXR 1.0.54
OpenXR: Running on OpenXR runtime:  SteamVR/OpenXR   2.14.5
OpenXR: xrGetD3D12GraphicsRequirementsKHR:
 - minFeatureLevel:  49152
D3D12 12_0 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060

OpenXR initialized successfully
```

Only left eye works. The right eye renders as fully black. system prompts appear on top of both eyes, as expected.
```
Godot Engine v4.6.1.stable.mono.official.14d19694e - https://godotengine.org
OpenXR: Created instance for OpenXR 1.0.54
OpenXR: Running on OpenXR runtime:  SteamVR/OpenXR   2.14.5
OpenXR: xrGetD3D12GraphicsRequirementsKHR:
 - minFeatureLevel:  49152
D3D12 12_0 - Forward Mobile - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060

OpenXR initialized successfully
```

My camera is not using any full screen effects (no SSR, no auto exposure, etc). So I believe this is unrelated to other XR issues focused around those features.

Minimal replication project here (10mb zip): 
http://kortham.net/temp/GodotProject-VR-DX12.zip



### Steps to reproduce

- Launch replication project.
- Launch steam and SteamVR.
- Open the TestScene.tscn.
- Confirm you've selected "Mobile", not "Forward+"
- Choose "Run Scene in XR Mode"
- Confirm d3d12 rendering (you can see that in the console)
- Don headset, observe left eye renders, right eye is all black.

- Swap to vulkan, observe both eyes work.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This is a C# project.

Minimal replication project here (10mb zip): 
http://kortham.net/temp/GodotProject-VR-DX12.zip
